title: Storage Extension
description: STAC Storage Extension for STAC Items, describing where a data file lives.

storage:facility.title: Facility
storage:facility.description: The facility operating the system, e.g. 'AWI', 'DKRZ'.

storage:system.title: System
storage:system.description: The name of the system, e.g. 'albedo', 'levante'.

storage:tier.title: Storage tier
storage:tier.description: Coarse-grained access-latency tier for the storage backing this file.

storage:type.title: Storage type
storage:type.description: The filesystem or storage technology backing this file, e.g. 'lustre', 'gpfs', 'hpss'.

storage:last_access.title: Last access time
storage:last_access.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the file's last access, as reported by the filesystem.
